what: What reached the cloud model, as Firebase AI monitoring logged it (resource type firebasevertexai.googleapis.com/Model), while five cases ran in the iPhone app on 2026-11-20 (iOS Simulator, iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 27, Apple on-device model). Every person, address, phone, email and account in the inputs is fictional (docs/test-sheets).
method: Each case was given to the app; afterwards every request logged for the project in that window was pulled from Cloud Logging and searched for each planted detail. Besides the words below, a request carries only WeKnow's fixed instructions and, for a pack pick, the names of the guides and prices in the pack index.
